title: NuclearScience Iodine131DecayAnalysis

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed flame speed vs chamber pressure analysis. Identified two distinct combustion regimes separated at 82.4 kPa. For Regime 1 (38.0-81.5 kPa), power law model provides best fit: y = 1178.98 × x^(-0.930) with R²=0.9991. For Regime 2 (82.4-97.5 kPa), linear model fits best: y = -0.1632x + 46.056 with R²=0.9452. Produced comprehensive report with methodology, results, figures, and discussion.
